Sub-Saharan Africa

Season near baseline

Sub-Saharan Africa logged 2,619 cases in April 2026, running well below the seasonal baseline.

Year-to-date totals sit at 19,857, running slightly above the expected burden.

Data refreshed: 11 May 2026

Burkina Faso

Burkina Faso is estimated to have experienced 11,397 cases this year to date. This is 2.3× the number of cases reported in an average year. This year the dengue situation in Burkina Faso is above average.
